outs.note: The show said OG Anunoby was downgraded to doubtful for 11/27 with a calf strain and looks one to two games from returning. Landry Shamet has started the last three games while Anunoby has been out.

The show said Jaylen Brown hurt his hamstring, and he played only 17 minutes on November 25. If he and Joel Embiid both sit, the show expects Tyrese Maxey, LeBron James, VJ Edgecombe, Jabari Walker and Anfernee Simons to gain.
Cade Cunningham was ruled out for 11/27 with a knee issue after also missing 11/24. The show said the knee is starting to become concerning, and Jalen Duren and Duncan Robinson are also out again.
Robinson has not played since 11/14. The show said he carries a questionable tag and his status for Friday is unclear.
Duren has not played since 10/23. The show said he has been practicing with the G League team and could return Friday, though his minutes would be uncertain.
RJ Barrett is out again on 11/27 and has not played since 11/17. Allen Graves has started both games Toronto has played since Barrett went out.
The Raptors said Kawhi Leonard will be out at least one more week. He has resumed on-court activities, but there is still no firm return date, and he has not played since October 23.
Lauri Markkanen (hand) was still out on Friday, Nov. 20, along with Jusuf Nurkic (foot) and Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), which leaves Utah without its starting frontcourt.

The show said Jaren Jackson Jr. is probably out at least another month; he has not played since October 26. The show said he will come back to a crowded Utah offense, with Darryn Peterson playing much better and Keyonte George taking a lot of shots.

Morant has a left hamstring strain and has not played since October 29. RotoWire lists December 1 as his earliest return, and the show estimated at least two more weeks until there are reports of contact work.
The show thinks Chris Youngblood will be out a while longer. He has a right heel contusion and has not played in Portland's recent games.

hot.why: Herro has topped 40 DraftKings points in three straight games while playing 37 to 40 minutes.
The show said Luka Doncic is wearing down without Austin Reaves because defenses are loading up on him and his teammates are not making shots.
Jaden McDaniels played 37 minutes and has been one of the best values in fantasy with Anthony Edwards out.

Joel Embiid has scored 50 or more DraftKings points in three straight games while taking 10 or more free throws in each one, including 26 points, 17 rebounds and nine assists in 34 minutes on November 21.
Svi Mykhailiuk played at least 28 minutes off the bench in four straight Jazz games from Nov. 17 to Nov. 22, and that run ended with 39 points and 10 threes in 32 minutes against Dallas.
